title: The Graduation
subtitle: A stage reward that takes the stage away
description: `remove: true` turns a stage reward into its inverse: this one takes `first_light:sworn` away instead of granting it, so the gate that opened the oath reads shut again. A stage is a flag, and both directions are one field.
Its line ends in `arrowHead: none`, a blunt end rather than a glyph — the fifth and last arrowhead, and the right one for a route that is an ending.
